meta.title: Pricing: free job search, Pro {{proPrice}} a month | Resume Booster
meta.description: Search jobs and scan your CV free. {{faPrice}} once for a Full Analysis, or {{proPrice}} a month for Pro's writing. All sales final; not sold in the EU, UK or India yet.

head.sub: Searching the board, CV scans, fit and your AI are free, and a free account adds saved searches, alerts, the tracker and one of each writing tool a day. You pay for more writing (Pro) or for one deeper report (Full Analysis).

before.finalBody: No refunds, except where the law requires one. Not happy with a paid result? Reply to your receipt and we make it again, free.
before.regionBody: Sales there wait until we are registered for VAT, or for GST in India. Checkout turns away buyers it can place there, from the currency, the time zone your device reports and a lookup of your IP address. Everything free works everywhere.
before.renewalBody: Prices are in US dollars. Pro renews every month at {{proPrice}} until you cancel, and you agree to the renewal with a separate tick box before checkout. The Full Analysis is one payment and never renews.

faq.refundA: No. All sales are final, except where the law requires a refund. If you are not happy with a paid result, reply to your receipt and we make it again at no charge, as our Terms say.
faq.regionQ: Why can't I buy from the EU, the EEA, the UK or India?
faq.regionA: We are not yet registered for VAT in the EU, the EEA and the UK, or for GST in India. Until we are, checkout turns away buyers it can place there, from the currency, the time zone your device reports and a lookup of your IP address. Searching, alerts, the tracker, the free scan, fit and your AI connection work everywhere.
faq.fitQ: Do I need an account to check my fit?
faq.fitA: No. Fit is free with or without an account. Signed out, it uses the CV you scanned or dropped on the board, in this browser. With a free account, your saved CV works on any device. Fit is a word match: it shows which of a posting's terms your CV uses. It does not predict interviews or offers.
faq.packageA: One job's set of writing: a tailored CV, a cover letter and interview prep. Pro allows {{perDay}} of each a day and {{perMonth}} of each a month, counted in UTC days. A free account allows {{freePerDay}} of each a day.
faq.cancelA: Cancel online from your account, the same way you signed up, any time. Cancelling stops the next renewal, and Pro stays on to the end of the month you paid for.
faq.applyQ: Do you apply to jobs for me?
faq.applyA: No, on any plan. Pro drafts for the jobs you pick; you review the drafts and apply on the employer's site, by hand or with help from Claude, ChatGPT or Claude Code.
faq.interviewsA: We can't promise that, and we don't estimate anyone's chances. The tools improve what you send; employers decide.
